scope: Offline exact-stamp-owned FollowPath intervals before initial obstacle-induced empty route, first40 observer seconds; not a closed-loop pass. Latest receipt-bounded map->odom and odom->base TF composition is an estimated map pose, not independently recorded AMCL pose or synchronized controller internal pose. Gazebo truth is independent. Recorder path XY rounded to0.1mm.
explicit_limitations: Ownership begins only at a MOVING status carrying exact published path_stamp; initial Spin MOVING excluded. Unowned early feedback is not used to infer route acceptance.
No equivalent-route alias ACK occurs in either first40s trace. We do not match nearby geometries or infer aliases from newer timestamps.
Each new owned ACK ends preceding route interval; empty path or terminal/wait/recovery also ends ownership. Last-published route alone is not evidence of execution.

Latest received TF composition at truth receipt time has map receipt<=250ms and odom receipt<=100ms. AMCL map->odom TF is future-stamped by transform tolerance; simultaneous controller map pose is not recorded. Freshest witness receipts are39ms/1ms for candidate,38ms/39ms for v2.

Polyline point-to-projection distance is geometric cross-track incl clamped endpoints. Whole-path box gap uses1mm samples; conservative continuous lower bound is value-0.5mm. Projection gap and actual body gap at witness are exact for axis-aligned25cm box and22cm circle.
Initial original global path intersects the newly spawned box as expected before obstacle replan. Claim of geometric clearance concerns replacement local routes, not the old pre-detection route.
Changes in actor position are applied by absolute wall_time of actual spawn/move events; deferred proposed movement is never treated as completed movement.
Closed-loop whole-system test result remains FAIL in both runs despite independent HOME success. These metrics diagnose accepted-route tracking; no source/runtime change was made.

code_witnesses.fact: Initial heading alignment gated by completion for entire explicit goal generation, not accepted replacement route or obstacle episode.
Any dispatched FollowPath marks initial alignment complete for goal generation. Subsequent changed local prefix bypasses existing heading-spin path.
Existing alignment error uses current-pose→path-progress+15cm lookahead vector.
Route horizon55cm; DWB sim_time2s; speed/angular command choices still native weighted critic output, not hard centerline following.
Plugin rejects excess linear/turn speed but delegates remaining trajectory scoring to native DWB; no hard cross-track/reorientation condition.
